mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation(title, user_id, model, model_config_id, del_flag, knowledge_base_id, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{userId}, #{model}, #{modelConfigId}, '0', #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET title = #{title}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET del_flag = '2', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message(conversation_id, role, content, reasoning_content, tokens, file_url, file_name, file_content, create_time) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{reasoningContent}, #{tokens}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileContent}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 100
